children: Japanese stocks may rise, tracking Wall Street's gains overnight. Concerns over the impact of high interest rates on the AI boom may ease, given Thursday's fall in U.S. Treasury yields. Investors are likely to focus on Fed Chair Warsh's fireside chat at an IMF event in Bangkok today for any clues on the central bank's rate-increase trajectory. Nikkei futures opened 730 points higher at 65405 on the SGX. The dollar is at 158.11 yen versus Y157.92 around Thursday's Tokyo market close. The Nikkei Stock Average closed 4.9% lower at 64425.95 on Thursday. (ronnie.harui@wsj.com)
